title: What's new: Agentic Developer Loop (2026 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Snapshot debugging setup and connection methods
Sampling profiling MCP demos and integrated workflow

features.name: Agentic developer loop
features.description: An AI-guided workflow for developers to investigate production problems by prompting an agent to understand source code, collect runtime evidence, and generate fixes. The agent coordinates snapshot debugging and profiling.

features.name: Snapshot debugging MCP
features.description: An MCP server built into Business Central that allows agents to capture runtime snapshots including call stacks and variables from production sessions, supporting iterative investigation with snap point placement via AL language server.
caveats: Requires configuring the MCP server for the Business Central environment
Agent can reuse existing AL language server insights to place snap points more effectively

features.name: AL tool as MCP proxy
features.description: The AL tool Swiss Army knife acts as an MCP host for the Business Central MCP server and as an MCP server for local clients, enabling snapshot debugging and sampling profiling capabilities.

features.name: Visual Studio Code MCP integration
features.description: Visual Studio Code can configure Business Central as an MCP target in launch.json, with the extension registering and starting the snapshot MCP proxy and reusing existing AI development sign-in.

features.name: AI language server protocol
features.description: The language server protocol is now available to agents as an industry standard, allowing them to resolve exact definition references, types, symbols, implementations, and callers instead of relying only on text search.

features.name: Sampling profiling MCP
features.description: An MCP server exposed through Business Central that captures AI CPU profile files and activity metrics including CQL calls, HTTP calls, and memory information. Agents can target specific session IDs or infer them from telemetry.
caveats: Requires numeric Business Central session ID to target
Agent can infer session ID from telemetry as alternative
Permissions required: create profile schedules and read performance profile for own session, or D365 attach debug for other sessions

features.name: Session-based profiling workflow
features.description: Users or agents can initiate limited sampling schedules by providing a Business Central session ID. The system watches matching activities and returns CPU profile files with activity duration, CQL and HTTP call metrics.
caveats: Session ID must be available; can be obtained from help and support page or inferred from telemetry

features.name: Telemetry-driven agent investigation
features.description: Agents can query telemetry to identify specific errors or performance issues, then automatically configure and trigger snapshot debugging or profiling with appropriate snap points or session IDs.
caveats: Polling frequency is configurable and in production scenarios runs at longer intervals than demo intervals
